row.title: ASHBY-1, ASHBY-SEARCH-1: code did not match Ashby's ultrastable system
row.body: Two mismatches in foundation/ultrastability.py, changed in this PR: tenant.value had no limits so it could never trigger the second loop (now the declared metric over the declared target, min 1.0; the check refuses an unbounded essential variable), and the second loop stopped searching after a 1-2 step ladder (now it draws untried parameter values, seeded, until one holds or the range is spent; tests/foundation/test_ultrastability.py 34 pass). Measured before the change: 14 second-order verdicts, 0 kept. Next measurement: second_loop_kept_share in research paper ashby-1952.
